paragraphs.title: KPIs — últimos 5 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  events           AS "Eventos",
  sessions         AS "Sessões",
  users            AS "Usuários",
  avg_duration_ms  AS "Tempo médio (ms)",
  avg_scroll_pct   AS "Scroll médio (%)",
  rage_clicks      AS "Rage clicks",
  page_views       AS "Page views"
FROM analytics.v_live_kpis

paragraphs.title: Eventos por minuto — últimos 60 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  bucket      AS "Minuto",
  events      AS "Eventos",
  sessions    AS "Sessões",
  page_views  AS "Page views",
  rage_clicks AS "Rage clicks"
FROM analytics.v_events_per_minute
ORDER BY bucket

paragraphs.title: Páginas mais vistas — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  path            AS "Página",
  views           AS "Views",
  sessions        AS "Sessões",
  avg_dwell_ms    AS "Dwell médio (ms)",
  avg_scroll_pct  AS "Scroll (%)"
FROM analytics.v_top_pages_15m

paragraphs.title: Cliques e atrito — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  element       AS "Elemento",
  path          AS "Página",
  clicks        AS "Cliques",
  rage_clicks   AS "Rage clicks",
  rage_rate_pct AS "Taxa rage (%)"
FROM analytics.v_click_heatmap_15m

paragraphs.title: Funil de uso — 24 horas
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  step     AS "Etapa",
  sessions AS "Sessões"
FROM analytics.v_funnel_24h
ORDER BY step

paragraphs.title: Dispositivos — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  device   AS "Dispositivo",
  events   AS "Eventos",
  sessions AS "Sessões"
FROM analytics.v_device_breakdown_15m

paragraphs.title: Atividade por papel — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  role     AS "Papel",
  events   AS "Eventos",
  sessions AS "Sessões",
  users    AS "Usuários"
FROM analytics.v_role_activity_15m

paragraphs.title: Sessões por usuário — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  user_id   AS "Usuário (pseudônimo)",
  role      AS "Papel",
  sessions  AS "Sessões",
  events    AS "Eventos",
  last_seen AS "Último evento"
FROM analytics.v_user_activity_15m

paragraphs.title: Páginas com maior tempo de permanência — 15 minutos
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  path           AS "Página",
  leaves         AS "Saídas",
  avg_dwell_ms   AS "Dwell médio (ms)",
  p90_dwell_ms   AS "P90 (ms)",
  avg_scroll_pct AS "Scroll (%)"
FROM analytics.v_slow_pages_15m

paragraphs.title: Eventos recentes
paragraphs.text:
%jdbc
SELECT
  event_ts    AS "Horário",
  event       AS "Evento",
  path        AS "Página",
  role        AS "Papel",
  device      AS "Dispositivo",
  element     AS "Elemento",
  duration_ms AS "Duração (ms)"
FROM analytics.events
ORDER BY event_ts DESC
LIMIT 50
